context.__customisation__: App-level config for this sample. This stack provisions only the SUPPORTING infrastructure (Bedrock Knowledge Base, Guardrail, CloudWatch) for the Strands Agents application in ../agents; the agents themselves run in process (demo) or on AgentCore Runtime. The defaults below deploy the fictional 'AnyCompany Energy' scenario. Override per-deploy with -c key=value, or edit the values here, to rebrand (companyName/companyShortName/agentPrefix/stackName). NOTE: changing agentPrefix renames the Knowledge Base, Guardrail and dashboard (new ids) and requires re-running the KB ingestion job + updating the demo env vars.
context.models_note: supervisorModelId/specialistModelId are the base foundation models the Strands agents use (the supervisor uses Opus for routing, specialists use Sonnet). The CDK uses them only to graph the matching Bedrock metrics on the CloudWatch dashboard; the runtime reads its own copies from demo/.env. The cross-region inference-profile geo (us./eu./apac.) is auto-detected from the deploy region.
context.inferenceProfileGeo_note: OPTIONAL / override-only. The inference-profile geo (US/EU/APAC) is auto-detected from the deploy region: us-* -> US, eu-*/me-*/af-* -> EU, ap-* -> APAC (unknown -> US). Set inferenceProfileGeo here (or -c inferenceProfileGeo=EU) only to override. US and EU Claude 4.x profiles exist today; an apac.* profile for Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6 is not yet published (see README 'Supported regions').
context.kbBucket_note: By default the stack creates its own S3 bucket and uploads the sample knowledge-base/*.md docs. To point the Knowledge Base at a bucket you already own, set existingKnowledgeBaseBucketArn (see example). When set, the stack skips bucket creation + sample upload and indexes your bucket; you must upload your docs and run the KB ingestion job yourself.
context.region_note: Region is resolved as: -c region=<X>  >  CDK_DEFAULT_REGION (from your AWS profile)  >  us-east-1. It is intentionally NOT pinned here so it follows your credentials by default. The Strands agents auto-detect the inference-profile geo from this region. US and EU regions work today; APAC is not yet supported for Claude 4.6 (see README 'Supported regions').

__customisation_example__.comment: Example overrides for a different company/industry/region. Copy these into the keys above (or pass with -c) to rebrand. These keys are ignored by CDK; they are documentation only.
